d: Short, straight cherry-pink hair with blunt-cut bangs and a small white wing accessory on the left side. Sharp, amber-gold eyes with a neutral, calm expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a high-cut, navy-blue sleeveless bodysuit with white trim, a matching hooded cape with long flowing white panels and gold eye-shaped ornaments at the ends, and sheer dark grey thigh-high stockings. Accessories include a black glove on the right hand and a red book wrapped in golden chains held in the left hand.
